description: Send the chairman a visual card (image) for something one of the other tools already answers. Use this FIRST when the user says things like 'send me that as a card', 'show it as a chart' or 'give me a picture': pass the name of that tool and the same dates you used. Re-runs that tool and returns its preset card(s). Day tools take date (default yesterday); range tools take start_date and end_date. Prefer this over compose_card.

parameters.label: Tool
parameters.description: Name of the existing tool whose result to show as a card.
parameters.options:
get_day_summary
get_month_to_date
get_branch_ranking
get_leakage_week
get_cashup_week
get_sales_range
get_top_bottom_dishes
get_order_type_and_payment_mix
get_cancellations
get_kitchen_speed
get_ideas_context

parameters.label: Start Date
parameters.description: First day (range tools). Same as used for that tool.

parameters.label: Date
parameters.description: Business day (day tools). Leave out for yesterday.
